description_en: Queries the published Thing Specification Language (TSL) model of a specified product
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定产品的已发布物模型TSL
name: GetThingModelTslPublished

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this ID value exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The resource group ID.

<notice>IoT Platform currently supports resource group management only at the instance level. The ResourceGroupId request parameter is no longer valid and does not need to be specified.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
资源组ID。

<notice>目前，物联网平台仅支持实例维度的资源组管理。请求参数ResourceGroupId配置已无效，无需再传入。
</notice>
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to retrieve the simplified TSL model.

true: Retrieves the simplified TSL model. The simplified TSL model contains only the identifiers (identifier) and data types (dataType) of properties, services, events, and their input and output parameters. This is intended for device-side developers.

false (default): Retrieves the complete TSL model. The complete TSL model contains all parameters and values defined for properties, services, and events. This is intended for cloud-side application developers
parameters.help_zh:
是否获取精简版物模型信息。

true：获取精简版物模型TSL。精简版物模型TSL中仅包含属性、服务、事件及入参、出参的标识符（identifier）、数据类型（dataType），可供设备端开发人员参考。

false（默认）：获取完整的物模型TSL。完整物模型TSL中包含属性、服务和事件定义的所有参数和取值，可供云端应用开发人员参考
parameters.name: simple

parameters.help_en:
The version number of the Thing Specification Language model.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150318.html to view the TSL model version numbers of a product.

If this parameter is left empty, the latest published version is returned
parameters.help_zh:
物模型版本号。

可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150318.html查看产品下的物模型版本号。

为空时返回已发布的最新版本
parameters.name: model_version

parameters.help_en:
The identifier of the custom module of the Thing Specification Language model. The identifier is unique within the product.

If this parameter is not specified, the data of the default module is queried
parameters.help_zh:
物模型自定义模块标识符，在产品中具有唯一性。

不传入此参数时，查询默认模块数据
parameters.name: function_block_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

TslStr.description_en: The TSL string of the Thing Specification Language model

TslUri.description_en: The URI of the Thing Specification Language model data stored in Object Storage Service (OSS). The returned URI is valid for 60 minutes
TslUri.description_zh: 物模型数据在对象存储（OSS）上的存储地址URI。返回的URI有效期为60分钟

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
